basic_info.description: This fantastic two-unit home offers flexibility for extended family living or potential condo conversion. The bright upper unit features two bedrooms and two full baths. The double parlor living room can easily be used as a third bedroom. Double doors open to the primary bedroom at the front of the building which is flooded with natural light from the bay window. High ceilings, original trim and a fireplace add to the appeal. The second bright bedroom, also located at the front of the building is a tranquil retreat. The large formal dining room leads to the remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and counter space. A stylishly remodeled bath is located off the kitchen. At the back of the home is a second full bath and laundry. From the laundry area there is access to the stairs leading to the verdant back yard. The entry of the ground floor home leads to the large, bright living room. The bedroom features a remodeled en-suite bath with a walk-in shower. The recently remodeled kitchen is a cook's delight. A-half bath is conveniently located at the back of the unit near the glass doors leading to the deck and garden. Laundry is located in the full basement. Located on a designated Noe Valley slow street.
